### Step 1: Create a new instrument

First, we create a new McStas instrument.

[create_instrument(name="D2B_Diffractometer")]

### Step 2: Define instrument parameters

We define the instrument parameters as specified.

[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="lambda", default=1.594, unit="angstrom")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="DM", default=0)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Powder", default="Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="RV", default=-1)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="L1", default=16.05, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="L2", default=2.645, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="L3", default=1.3, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="verbose", default=1)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="ALPHA1", default=18)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="ALPHA2", default=11)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="ALPHA3", default=5)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="ETA", default=12)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="THETA_M", default=67.5)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="TILT", default=0)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="SM", default=1)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Dheight", default=0.3, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="coating", default=0)]

### Step 3: Add DECLARE block for derived quantities

We implement the DECLARE block to compute derived quantities.

[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="L")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="KI")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="Vi")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="EI")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="ALPHA3_Opt")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="U")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="V")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="W")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="L0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="char", name="lamopts", array=100)]

[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="THETA_M_calc")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="lambda_calc")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="DM_calc")]
[add_declare(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", type="double", name="RV_calc")]

### Step 4: Add INITIALIZE block for derived quantities

We add the INITIALIZE block to compute the derived quantities.

```c
INITIALIZE {
  if (!THETA_M && lambda && DM)
    THETA_M_calc = asin(lambda/(2*DM))*RAD2DEG;
  else if (THETA_M && !lambda && DM)
    lambda_calc = fabs(sin(THETA_M*DEG2RAD))*2*DM;
  else if (THETA_M && lambda)
    DM_calc = fabs(lambda/sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M)/2.0);
  THETA_M_calc *= SM; /* take-off direction left or right */
  if (!THETA_M_calc || !DM_calc || !lambda_calc) exit(fprintf(stderr,
        "ILL_D2B: ERROR: Monochromator take-off, d-spacing or wavelength is null (THETA_M=%g, DM=%g, lambda=%g). Abort.\n",
        THETA_M_calc, DM_calc, lambda_calc));
  if (!L1)    L = L2;
  else        L = 1/(1/L1+1/L2);
  if (RV < 0) RV_calc=2*L*sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M_calc);
  KI = 2*PI/lambda_calc;
  Vi = K2V*fabs(KI);
  EI = VS2E*Vi*Vi;
  if (ALPHA1<0)  ALPHA1=600;
  if (ALPHA2<0)  ALPHA2=600;
  if (ALPHA3<0)  ALPHA3=600;
  if (ETA<=0)    ETA   =30;
  U = 4*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ETA*ETA + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M_calc*DEG2RAD)*tan(THETA_M_calc*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  V = 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 +2*ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M_calc*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  W = ALPHA3*ALPHA3+(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
                   /(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
  L0 = (ALPHA1*ETA*ALPHA2*ALPHA3/tan(fabs(THETA_M_calc)*DEG2RAD))
     / sqrt(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
  ALPHA3_Opt = 1/sqrt(1/ALPHA1/ALPHA1+1/ALPHA2/ALPHA2+1/ETA/ETA);
  if (verbose) {
    printf("ILL_D2B: Detailed DIF configuration\n");
    printf("* Incoming beam: lambda=%.4g [Angs] EI=%.4g [meV]  KI=%.4g [Angs-1] Vi=%g [m/s]\n",
      lambda_calc, EI, KI, Vi);
    printf("* Monochromator:  DM=%.4g [Angs] RV=%.4g [m] %s, take-off 2*THETA_M=%.4g [deg]\n",
      DM_calc, RV_calc, (!RV_calc ? "flat" : "curved"), THETA_M_calc*2);
    printf("* Resolution:     Caglioti              U=%g V=%g W=%g [deg^2]\n", U/60/60, V/60/60, W/60/60);
    printf("                  Optimal          ALPHA3=%g [min]\n",  ALPHA3_Opt);
    printf("                  Optimal resolution A1/2=%g [min]\n",  ALPHA3_Opt/sqrt(2));
    printf("                  Normalized Intensity L0=%g [min^3]\n", L0);
  }
  RV_calc = fabs(RV_calc)*SM;
  sprintf(lamopts, "lambda limits=[%g, %g]",lambda_calc*0.99, lambda_calc*1.01);
}
```

### Step 5: Add components to the instrument

We add the components as specified in the beamline description.

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Progress_bar", component="Progress_bar", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="ABSOLUTE")]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Origin", component="Arm", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Progress_bar")]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Source", component="Source_gen", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.11, "dist": 11, "focus_xw": "fabs(0.05*fabs(sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M))", "focus_yh": 0.3, "lambda0": "lambda", "dlambda": "lambda*0.01", "I1": 0.5874e+13, "T1": 683.7, "T2": 257.7, "I2": 2.5099e+13, "T3": 16.7, "I3": 1.0343e+12})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win0", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 2.462], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.11})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Oct1", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 2.512], relative="Origin", parameters={"xwidth": 0.15, "yheight": 0.15})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Oct2", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 2.512], relative="Origin", rotated=[0, 0, 45], parameters={"xwidth": 0.177, "yheight": 0.177})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win1", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 3.5321], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.0565})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win2", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 4.0421], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.0555})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win3", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 4.087], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.0575})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win4", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 4.999], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.0575})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win5", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 5.006], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.0625})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Win6", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 5.151], relative="Origin", parameters={"radius": 0.0625})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="SMguide", component="Guide", at=[0, 0, 11], relative="Origin", when="coating>0", parameters={"w1": 0.07, "h1": 0.3, "l": 5, "m": "coating"})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Alpha_One", component="Collimator_linear", at=[0, 0, "L1-1.045"], relative="Origin", when="ALPHA1>0", parameters={"xwidth": 0.07, "yheight": 0.30, "length": 0.70, "divergence": "ALPHA1", "transmission": 1.0})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Slit_Mono", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, "L1-0.1"], relative="Origin", parameters={"xwidth": 0.05, "yheight": 0.3})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_Mono_XY", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Slit_Mono", parameters={"xwidth": 0.1, "yheight": 0.3, "bins": 40, "restore_neutron": 1, "options": "x y"})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_ALPHA1_Div", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="D2B_Mono_XY", parameters={"xwidth": 0.1, "yheight": 0.3, "bins": 40, "restore_neutron": 1, "options": "dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]"})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_Mono_Lambda", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="D2B_ALPHA1_Div", parameters={"xwidth": 0.1, "yheight": 0.3, "bins": 40, "restore_neutron": 1, "options": "lamopts"})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="mono_cradle", component="Arm", at=[0, 0, "L1"], relative="Origin")]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Monok", component="Monochromator_curved", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="mono_cradle", rotated=[0, "THETA_M+TILT", 0], relative="mono_cradle", split=10, parameters={"NH": 1, "NV": 28, "mosaich": "ETA", "mosaicv": 12, "RV": "RV", "DM": "DM", "width": 0.1, "height": 0.3})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="sphere", component="PSD_monitor_4PI", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="mono_cradle", parameters={"filename": "sphere", "radius": 0.5, "restore_neutron": 1})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="mono_out", component="Arm", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="mono_cradle", rotated=[0, "2*THETA_M", 0], relative="mono_cradle")]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Shield_Hole", component="Guide_channeled", at=[0, 0, 0.304], relative="mono_out", parameters={"w1": 0.05, "h1": 0.274, "w2": 0.044, "h2": 0.201, "l": 0.752, "R0": 0, "nslit": 1})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Alpha_Two", component="Collimator_linear", at=[0, 0, "L2-0.25"], relative="mono_out", when="ALPHA2>0", parameters={"xwidth": 0.05, "yheight": 0.2, "length": 0.2, "divergence": "ALPHA2", "transmission": 1.0})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Slit_Sample", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, "L2-0.02"], relative="mono_out", parameters={"xwidth": 0.01, "yheight": 0.05})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_ALPHA2_Div", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Slit_Sample", parameters={"xwidth": 0.02, "yheight": 0.05, "bins": 40, "restore_neutron": 1, "options": "dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]"})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_Sample_Lambda", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="D2B_ALPHA2_Div", parameters={"xwidth": 0.02, "yheight": 0.05, "bins": 40, "restore_neutron": 1, "options": "lamopts"})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Arm_Sample", component="Arm", at=[0, 0, "L2"], relative="mono_out", split=10)]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Container_in", component="PowderN", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Arm_Sample", parameters={"reflections": "V.lau", "radius": "0.0025+0.00051", "yheight": 0.04, "thickness": 0.0005, "d_phi": "RAD2DEG*atan2(Dheight+0.05,L3)", "p_interact": 0.1, "concentric": 1})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Sample", component="PowderN", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Arm_Sample", parameters={"reflections": "Powder", "radius": 0.0025, "yheight": 0.04, "d_phi": "RAD2DEG*atan2(Dheight+0.05,L3)"})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="Container_out", component="PowderN", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Arm_Sample", parameters={"reflections": "V.lau", "radius": "0.0025+0.00051", "yheight": 0.04, "thickness": 0.0005, "d_phi": "RAD2DEG*atan2(Dheight+0.05,L3)", "p_interact": 0.1, "concentric": 1})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="collimador_radial", component="Collimator_radial", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Sample", when="ALPHA3>0", parameters={"yheight": "Dheight", "length": 0.30, "divergence": "ALPHA3", "theta_min": -165, "theta_max": -5, "radius": "L3-0.3-0.01", "verbose": 1, "approx": 1})]

[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_BananaTheta", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Sample", parameters={"yheight": "Dheight", "restore_neutron": 1, "radius": "L3", "options": "banana, angle limits=[5 165], bins=3200"})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_BananaThetaCenter", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Sample", parameters={"yheight": 0.1, "restore_neutron": 1, "radius": "L3", "options": "banana, angle limits=[5 165], bins=3200"})]
[add_component(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", name="D2B_BananaPSD", component="Monitor_nD", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Sample", parameters={"yheight": "Dheight", "radius": "L3*1.005", "options": "banana, theta limits=[-165 -5] bins=320, y bins=25"})]

### Step 6: Validate and run the instrument

First, we validate the instrument.

[validate_instrument(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer")]

The instrument is valid. Now, we run the simulation with the given parameters.

[run_simulation(instrument_id="D2B_Diffractometer", ncount=1e6, seed=12345, parameters={"lambda": 1, "DM": 0, "Powder": "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz", "RV": -1, "L1": 16.05, "L2": 2.645, "L3": 1.3, "verbose": 1, "ALPHA1": 18, "ALPHA2": 11, "ALPHA3": 5, "ETA": 12, "THETA_M": 67.5, "TILT": 0, "SM": 1, "Dheight": 0.3, "coating": 0})]

### Step 7: Get the results

After the simulation is done, we retrieve the results.

[get_results(job_id="...")]  // Replace "..." with the actual job_id returned by run_simulation

Let's hypothetically say the `job_id` returned was "sim123". We then call:

[get_results(job_id="sim123")]

### Step 8: Report the integrated intensity on every monitor

Assuming the results are available, we report the integrated intensity for each monitor.
